A LITTLE FIELD GUIDE

From messy to ready.

  1. Bring your inventory.

    Import a UTF-8 CSV or TSV with a header row, or explore the sample. Commas, tabs, and semicolons are detected automatically.

  2. Choose what to clean.

    Preview whitespace, SKU, category, and price fixes. Duplicate removal only removes identical rows after the selected fixes.

  3. Review the details.

    Compare Current and Preview, then apply. Click any cell to edit it. Missing values, conflicting SKUs, and ambiguous numbers stay flagged for you.

  4. Take it with you.

    Export your result as CSV. Undo your last 20 edits or reset to the original file anytime. Refreshing closes the workspace, so download before leaving.

Price cleanup uses a decimal point and comma thousands separators. Values such as 12,50 are left for manual review. Your file never leaves this browser.

Replace this workspace?

Your current edits will be lost. Export first if you want to keep them.
